header.label: Historical construction literature
header.desc: Digitized historical construction and architecture books, freely accessible for engineers, architects and builders.

why.title: Why OpenBooks?
why.desc: Anyone who renovates, restores or assesses an existing building needs to know how it was built: which brick bonds, foundations, window frames and calculation methods were common at the time. That knowledge lives in trade books that have been out of print for decades.
why.desc2: OpenBooks scans these books and puts them online for free. No account, no subscription: page through the original scans, zoom in on the drawings and search the text of the books that have already been processed with OCR.

reader.label: Reader
reader.title: How to use the collection
reader.desc: The library runs in the browser. Pick a category, open a book and page through the original scans.
reader.c1: Categories Architecture, construction, calculations, steel, timber, regulations and classical.
reader.c2: Reader Zoom in, turn pages and jump straight to a page number.
reader.c3: Search Search by title and author, and in the full text of books with OCR.
reader.c4: Open source Scans and code are on GitHub; new books can be submitted as a contribution.

wattjes.title: Prof. J.G. Wattjes (10 volumes)
wattjes.desc: Complete series on construction: walls, chimneys, foundations, windows/doors, floor systems, vaults, stairs, roof constructions, and more.

gugel.title: Prof. E.H. Gugel
gugel.desc: Architectonische Vormenleer (1880): architectural design theory and form language.

potma.title: Ir. A.P. Potma & Ir. J.E. de Vries
potma.desc: Staalconstructies: theory, calculation, and execution of steel structures.

vandepitte.title: Prof. D. Vandepitte (3 volumes)
vandepitte.desc: Berekening van Constructies: structural calculation theory across three comprehensive volumes.

zwiers.title: L. Zwiers
zwiers.desc: Houtconstructies Handboek: handbook for timber construction design.

bosboom.title: Symon Bosboom
bosboom.desc: Cort onderwys van de vyf colommen: historical treatise on the five classical orders by city stonemason of Dordrecht.

codes.title: Building codes
codes.desc: Historical Dutch building regulations: G.B.V. Gewapend Beton Voorschriften (1950) and VB Voorschriften Beton (1974).
